title: A Conditional Sieve Criterion for Twin Primes via Krafft Geometry
abstract: Introduces an original conditional sieve criterion for the Twin Prime Conjecture. Using a centered modular alignment (termed the Krafft alignment), proves that if the Rayleigh-Ritz quotient over the orthogonal unit sphere satisfies muMin < 1, then a twin prime pair must exist in the corresponding interval.

informal.KrafftSieve.krafft_sieve_guarantee_with_: Proves that muMin n < 1 is a sufficient condition for the existence of a twin prime pair in the corresponding interval.
informal.KrafftSieve.mu_min_lt_one_implies_tpc: If there are infinitely many intervals where the optimal multidimensional weight achieves a ratio strictly less than 1, then there are infinitely many twin primes. This is a conditional reduction; the hypothesis muMin n < 1 is not established here for any n.
